text: {"overall_winner": "A", "qualities": [{"evidence": "Clear paragraph structure with introductory and concluding paragraphs plus dedicated body paragraphs for skills and talents", "quality": "Structural Organization", "description": "Measures how well an essay uses logical paragraphing and transitions to arrange ideas cleanly."}, {"evidence": "Capitalization of sentence starters and proper nouns, along with standard punctuation at sentence boundaries", "quality": "Mechanics and Punctuation", "description": "Captures a writer's control over basic mechanics such as sentence capitalization and appropriate ending punctuation marks."}, {"evidence": "Variety in clause structures using conditional and reason phrases like \"because I can draw what I'm feeling\" and \"for more movement\"", "quality": "Syntactic Complexity", "description": "Reflects the ability to construct varied, multi-clause sentences that clearly articulate relationships between ideas."}, {"evidence": "Precise action phrases such as \"pushing air in my throat\" and \"ball up my fist\"", "quality": "Descriptive Vocabulary", "description": "Reflects the use of specific, expressive words and phrases to convey vivid detail."}]}
